title: Opentrons Heater Shaker Module Beta Test Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Wait until the shake time has elapsed.
Stop shaking (current rpm reported to the log).

steps.title: Open and close heater latch
steps.instruction: Open the heater‑shaker latch, log the latch status, then close the latch and log the status again.

steps.title: Set heater target temperature
steps.instruction: Set the heater‑shaker to the user‑specified target temperature (between 37 °C and 95 °C) and proceed without waiting; log the current temperature.

steps.title: Log selected heater wells
steps.instruction: Report to the log the heater‑shaker wells selected for dispensing, based on the user‑defined every‑nth‑column parameter.

steps.title: Transfer liquid to heater shaker
steps.instruction: Using the selected single‑ or multi‑channel pipette, dispense the user‑specified transfer volume from the chosen source labware (well plate or reservoir) into the selected heater‑shaker labware.

steps.title: Wait for temperature to reach target
steps.instruction: Wait until the heater‑shaker reaches the set temperature, continuously reporting the current temperature to the log.

steps.title: Start shaking and record time
steps.instruction: Start shaking at the user‑specified speed (recommended 200–2000 rpm, up to 3000 rpm) and record the start time.

steps.title: Mix in destination plate during shake
steps.instruction: During shaking, use the same pipette to perform a mixing operation in the destination labware (well plate or reservoir) to demonstrate pipetting not targeting the heater‑shaker.

steps.title: Wait for shaking duration
steps.instruction: Continue shaking for the user‑specified duration (minutes) and wait until this time has elapsed.

steps.title: Stop shaking and log rpm
steps.instruction: Stop shaking and log the current RPM.

steps.title: Transfer 80% liquid to destination
steps.instruction: Using the pipette, transfer 80 % of the previously dispensed volume from the heater‑shaker to the destination labware.

steps.title: Deactivate heater (passive cooling)
steps.instruction: Deactivate the heater to allow passive cooling.

steps.title: Open heater latch to finish
steps.instruction: Open the heater‑shaker latch and log the final status; protocol complete.
